description_en: Invoke FuzzyMatchDomainSensitiveWord to check whether a domain name contains sensitive words.
description_zh: 调用FuzzyMatchDomainSensitiveWord检查域名是否包含敏感词
kebab_example: aliyun domain fuzzy-match-domain-sensitive-word --keyword xxx00 --lang en --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: FuzzyMatchDomainSensitiveWord

parameters.help_en: The domain name keyword (a term contained in the domain name excluding its suffix). Separate multiple keywords with commas (,).
parameters.help_zh: 域名关键字（除域名后缀外包含的词语），多个域名关键字之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message returned by the API. Valid values:  
zh: Chinese  
en: English  

Default value: en.
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息的语言。取值范围：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The User IP address. You can set this parameter to 127.0.0.1.
parameters.name: user_client_ip

Exist.description_en:
Indicates whether the domain name contains sensitive words. Valid values:  
true: The domain name contains sensitive words.  
false: The domain name does not contain sensitive words.
Exist.description_zh:
域名是否包含敏感词。取值：
true：含敏感词。
false：不含敏感词

Keyword.description_en: The domain name keyword that was passed in.

MatchedSensitiveWord.description_en: Details of the matched sensitive words found in the domain name. If the value of the Exist parameter is false, the matching result is empty
MatchedSensitiveWord.description_zh: 匹配到域名中包含敏感词的结果详情。当Exist参数的取值为false时，匹配结果为空

Word.description_en: A sensitive word matched in the domain name
Word.description_zh: 匹配到域名中包含的敏感词
